description: Using limit=0 as the sentinel for cannotCalculateChanges (not tooManyChanges) is a sound protocol design choice, well-tested (backend.rs tests), and correctly documented. A contributor might want to unify these into a single variant or change the sentinel. Resist: the distinction between 'can never calculate changes' and 'changes exceed a limit' is important for clients — tooManyChanges lets clients retry with a smaller sinceState window.
title: BackendChangesError TooManyChanges{limit:0} = cannotCalculateChanges is correct
